items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: When I say Tommy Dorsey I'm thinking of Bennie Carter, Mr. Bennie Carter, because Tommy Douglas was like Mr. Bennie Carter...

ctx.x: Saxophone and clarinet... When I say Tommy Dorsey I'm thinking of Bennie Carter, Mr. Bennie Carter, because Tommy Douglas was like Mr. Bennie Carter...
Joined them in Joplin, Missouri, huh?
